review.recipe: Single chilled stemmed wine glass with narrowing bowl, rosy amber-orange shaken Bronx riff, tiny froth, no pulp/seeds/ice/garnish.
review.personality: Worn clock and small game timer with crumpled paper party crown show deliberate organised fun and a past theme; close group survives portrait with part of crown trimmed.
review.world: Dark worn walnut and burgundy room, single warm lamp camera right, neutral shadows.
